mapper.select: SELECT sum(amount) FROM referral_commission WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT sum(rc.amount) as amount, u.user_name, u.avatar FROM referral_commission rc LEFT JOIN gift_order go ON rc.order_id = go.id LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_id = go.user_id where rc.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY go.user_id ORDER BY amount
